description: honua-server hands operators and agents absolute documentation URLs at runtime under https://honua.io/docs/<path>/ (a typed refusal's remediationRef, the SCIM documentationUri, a Prometheus runbook_url). Those pages are rendered on GitBook, not here, so without these entries every one of them is a 404 on honua.io. scripts/gen-runtime-docs-redirects.mjs writes a redirect page per path into dist/docs/; the fragment is carried so a link to a heading still lands on that heading. Keep this in step with honua-server scripts/ci/code-referenced-anchors.v1.json: --verify-remote fails when the server registers a path this file does not cover, or when a target or anchor no longer resolves.
